utterances.text: This one. Okay. Pull the pin. Do it.
Wait, Grandma, if I just yank it horizontally it should pop right out. It’s faster that way.
No, no, no! You'll snap the housing doing that. You have to twist it clockwise first to release the tension, then slide it. We aren't in a race.
But it’s a spring-loaded pin! My teacher said yanking is the standard way so it doesn't get stuck midway.
I don't care what your teacher said, I've had this machine forty years and if you yank it, you'll ruin it. Now, hold it steady and wait until I say so. We’re doing it the right way or not at all.
Here we go. Here we go.
Pull the pin. Let's do that after. Okay, now push down on that thing. Just hold it down like that a little bit.
Oops. Okay, let go of it.
